{{Quote|Spinnaker is Naboo's chief supply center. Your mission is to disrupt the supply lines, OOM-9.|Nute Gunray|audio=GunraySpinnaker-GB.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''invasion of Spinnaker''' was a battle that took place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] had wanted to confirm that the invasion would be profitable, so he tasked the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] with gathering 10,000 [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from the wealthy [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] began by occupying a [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]] near Spinnaker, which surrendered quickly and became the Trade Federation's base of operations.

The village came under attack by forces from Spinnaker and the [[Naboo Royal Navy]], but the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] repelled them and built additional forces. OOM-9 took control of the roads between Spinnaker, the naval [[Naboo Royal Navy base|base]], and the village, causing the Naboo to waste forces trying to retake them. The Droid Army then focused on eliminating the Royal Navy, doing so with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]]. With the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] defeated, OOM-9 subsequently attacked Spinnaker, destroying the defensive capabilities of the city before taking control of its [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] to extract nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] from them. After accumulating 10,000 nova crystals, OOM-9 destroyed Spinnaker's spaceports, and the Droid Army proceeded to [[Capture of Theed/Legends|capture]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Lord Sidious, we have located Naboo's chief supply center. It seems that all materials that are collected on Naboo are sent through this location, stored temporarily in spaceports before being sent offworld. Our blockade stops these resources from being transported away, and thus, their stockpiles must be overflowing.|Nute Gunray, transmitting to Darth Sidious|audio=SpinnakerIntro.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in protest of [[Senate Resolution BR-0371]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] taxation law that had significantly reduced the company's profits. After conquering several Naboo [[City/Legends|cities]], the greedy<ref name="GB" /> [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] lost confidence in the profitability of the invasion<ref name="Prima" /> and grew impatient to see it bear fruit. He wanted to obtain 10,000 [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], a type of [[Currency/Legends|currency]], before committing to the costly [[Capture of Theed/Legends|invasion]] of Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]<ref name="GB" /> as proof of the value of occupying Naboo.<ref name="Prima" /> The city [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] was Naboo's main supply center: all trading materials were stored in its [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] before being sent off-world. The Trade Federation's [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the planet prevented off-world shipments and Spinnaker's stockpiles of nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] were overflowing, which Gunray mentioned in a transmission to his secret benefactor, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Spinnaker_beginning.png|thumb|right|300px|The initial Trade Federation forces for the invasion]]
Immediately after the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] exceeded Gunray's expectations by [[Capture of Harte Secur|conquering]] the city [[Harte Secur]], Gunray confirmed that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was required to lead the invasion of Spinnaker. OOM-9, who commanded the invasion remotely, was instructed to destroy three of the spaceports in Spinnaker and replace them with Trade Federation spaceports. The portion of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] assigned to take Spinnaker included six heavy [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], six [[E4 baron droid|baron battle droids]], three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], three manned [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], and two [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]], one containing ten [[Heavy Battle Droid/Legends|Heavy Battle Droids]] and the other holding ten [[Grenade droid/Legends|droid grenadiers]].<ref name="GB" />

==The invasion==
===Digging in===
{{Quote|We surrender! Our village is yours. Take whatever you want.|A royal trooper relinquishing his village to the Trade Federation|audio=RoyalTrooperSurrender.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Droidekas_roll_in.png|thumb|left|300px|OOM-9's droidekas roll in to the village.]]
The droids and [[Mech/Legends|mechs]] arrived near a [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]] south of Spinnaker. The village was guarded by eight [[Security Guard/Legends|royal troopers]],<ref name="GB" /> who exited from the southern gate to confront the approaching Trade Federation forces. The droids [[Death/Legends|killed]] everyone they encountered on the path and the droidekas rolled in to the village through the open gate.<ref name="Prima" /> The village immediately surrendered, and a [[Unidentified royal trooper|royal trooper]] offered the village to the Trade Federation while begging for the inhabitants not to be harmed.<ref name="GB" /> OOM-9 focused on stablizing the village so it could be used as a base, sending the [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] forces to protect the northern entrance and the rest of his troops to protect the east. The Trade Federation also put the village's [[PKN-49 worker droid]]s to work gathering [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from nearby deposits and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from [[Tree/Legends|trees]], using the ore to build two [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] and [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turrets]] along the northern and western walls.<ref name="Prima" /> The Trade Federation also assembled their own [[OX9]] labor droids to assist in the invasion.<ref name="GB" />

The droids strategized to fortify their position before annihilating the Royal Navy and Spinnaker's forces. After gaining control of the [[Water/Legends|river]] that stretched from the east to the south of the village, the droids manufactured [[utility trawler]]s at the village [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] to gather [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="Prima" /> Spinnaker sent an initial force to the village, including three heavy [[V-19 landspeeder]]s, four [[Champion (vehicle)|Heavy Champion]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcrafts]], and two [[Steadfast (tank)|Steadfast]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]]. The [[Naboo Royal Navy]], operating from a [[Naboo Royal Navy base|base]] west of the village, also sent four [[Royal crusader]]s, three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], three [[Naboo energy catapult]]s,<ref name="GB" /> and three [[Tuskcat Trooper]]s<ref name="CC" /> to attack the village. The droids were able to ward off the attacks, forcing the Naboo to take [[Time/Legends|time]] to regroup. During the reprieve, the droids built at least one [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]], a mech [[Factory/Legends|factory]], and a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] and began creating [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid Starfighters]], Armored Assault Tanks, [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|missile battle droids]], the latter of which they dispersed throughout the village for air protection.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Spinnaker_road.png|thumb|right|300px|The droids took control of the roads between the village and Spinnaker, using turrets and fighters.]]
Spinnaker made another unsuccessful attack with a force consisting of eight royal [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],<ref name="GB" /> four heavy Tuskcat Troopers,<ref name="CC" /> six heavy V-19 [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], two [[Champion (vehicle)|Champions]], and one Steadfast.<ref name="GB" /> The droids began repelling the aquatic attacks of the Royal Navy, taking control of the strip of land between their base and the village. OOM-9 used five [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and several troopers to protect a group of [[Labor droid/Legends|worker droids]], who went to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] path between Spinnaker and the village to build at least one turret and a [[carbon processing center]], after which the droids began to harvest carbon from the trees. By taking control of the road between Spinnaker and the village, OOM-9 ensured constant access to carbon, while also forcing Spinnaker to waste some of its forces attempting to recapture the path, at which point they could be picked off by the droid forces. OOM-9 repeated that strategy to weaken the forces of the Naboo Royal Navy to the west, taking control of a stockpile of nova crystals there by using six fighters and three workers who built two turrets.<ref name="Prima" />

===The Trade Federation strikes===
{{Quote|Construct a spaceport to transfer the resources to us.|Nute Gunray to OOM-9|audio=GunrayConstructASpaceport.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Pummels_burn_Spinnaker.png|thumb|left|300px|Trade Federation pummels attack a fortress in Spinnaker.]]
OOM-9 focused first on crushing the Naboo Royal Navy, sending out ten fighters first to destroy any [[Boat/Legends|boats]] remaining in the river, and using them to continue to pick off turrets and soldiers on the road. The Trade Federation sent [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]] into the naval base to destroy its [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], losing at least one to the fortress autoturrets. After the fortress was destroyed, OOM-9 sent in fighters to eliminate any survivors from the base while the pummels destroyed the buildings. OOM-9 began sending [[Neimoidian trader]]s, a type of repulsorcraft, to retrieve nova crystals from<ref name="Prima" /> the [[YIN-762's base|base]] of [[YIN-762]], another Trade Federation battle droid.<ref name="GB" />

The Trade Federation then proceeded to use its fighters to clear the turrets in Spinnaker's southwestern region, while its ground forces entered the southwestern gate. The fighters then attacked the remaining boats,<ref name="Prima" /> including the [[Spinnaker Navy]]'s four [[Destroyer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|destroyers]], two [[Cruiser (Naboo)|cruisers]], and five [[Scout (Royal Naboo)|Light Scouts]], and any buildings outside of the range of anti-air turrets. OOM-9 used his remaining droidekas to guard at least three pummels as they attacked Spinnaker, sustaining heavy damage from turrets by the time they had destroyed the city's power cores and fortresses. The Trade Federation left the spaceports intact to continue exporting nova crystals from them. OOM-9 also targeted a [[Unidentified Naboo town|trading town]] across the bay north of Spinnaker, loading a pummel into an transport to destroy the turrets located in it and trade with its spaceports afterwards. After accumulating 10,000 nova crystals, Gunray congratulated OOM-9 for his efforts and stated that the full-scale invasion was ready to begin.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The road between Spinnaker and Theed is not a long one.|Nute Gunray|audio=SpinnakerAndTheed.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Naboo_Resistance_Spinnaker.png|thumb|right|300px|The Naboo Resistance battles the Trade Federation in the ruins of Spinnaker.]]
As Spinnaker was a short distance from Theed, Naboo's [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Human]] capital, the invasion of Spinnaker put the Trade Federation in an ideal position to attack it,<ref name="GB" /> which they did so on the day after the Droid Army had landed on the planet.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> The Trade Federation occupied the ruins of Spinnaker, building a [[Neimoidian Throne]] in its center to symbolize their dominance. They established [[Camp 14]] near the trading town to hold Naboo and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. The [[Naboo Resistance]] held control of a portion of Spinnaker and fought against Trade Federation control for some time after the invasion. The camp and the remains of the city were later [[Liberation of Spinnaker|liberated]] by the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] at the command of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], who sought to expand the [[Army/Legends|army's]] size to fight off the Trade Federation in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Overview===
{{Quote|You are needed for the invasion of Spinnaker.|Nute Gunray, giving the name of the battle in his orders to OOM-9|audio=InvasionOfSpinnaker.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_campaign.png|thumb|right|300px|The menu for the Trade Federation campaign in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'']]
The invasion of Spinnaker was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]], published on on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]] the same year.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The invasion constitutes the third level of the Trade Federation campaign, titled "Spinnaker's Spoils," and its name was given by dialogue by Nute Gunray in the previous level, "Behind the Lines."<ref name="GB" />

The player has the objective of earning 10,000 nova crystals, destroying Spinnaker's three spaceports, and constructing their own on top of them. In ''Galactic Battlegrounds'', nova crystals are achieved through mining deposits found throughout the map and sending [[Hovercraft|cargo hovercrafts]] to retrieve nova crystals from spaceports belonging to allied or enemy players.<ref name="GB" />

===Strategy guide differences===
The strategy guide states that the player starts "Spinnaker's Spoils" with nine heavy battle droids and six droid grenadiers,<ref name="Prima" /> but in the game itself, the player is given ten of each.<ref name="GB" /> It states that a [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry beacon]] is present outside the village at the start of the level and that the player should destroy it,<ref name="Prima" /> but this does not appear in the game.<ref name="GB" /> Likewise, the guide states that the Naboo Royal Navy base contains more than one fortress, anti-aircraft turrets, and a spaceport,<ref name="Prima" /> but these are all absent in the level.<ref name="GB" /> If the player finds taking the road between the village and the Naboo Royal Navy too difficult, the strategy guide recommends using their workers to repair their turrets or even construct a fortress. The guide also notes that the player can lose the level if they damage the Naboo village substantially or take too long to attack it.<ref name="Prima" />

The strategy guide recommends that the player use their MTTs to destroy the Spinnaker Navy's [[Missile Destroyer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|anti-air destroyers]],<ref name="Prima" /> but none of the destroyers appear in the level.<ref name="GB" /> The strategy guide advises that the player should keep the various enemy spaceports active to continue trading with them to earn nova crystals, and that the player could potentially lose if they destroyed all of Spinnaker's spaceports. It also states that once the player earns the required nova crystals they will need to destroy the remaining spaceports in Spinnaker to finish the level.<ref name="Prima" /> The level functions differently, rewarding the player with a large quantity of nova crystals if they destroy spaceports and stating in the instructions that the player needs to construct their own spaceports on top of those in Spinnaker after destroying them. However, in the game the player automatically achieves victory as soon as they possess 10,000 nova crystals.<ref name="GB" />

===Difficulty level differences, miscellaneous features, and unused content===
{{Quote|Use Maul to secure the buildings.|Nute Gunray in unused dialogue|audio=DarthMaulSpinnaker.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Spinnaker_minimap.png|thumb|left|300px|Full view of the minimap of the battle at the start of hard difficulty. Trade Federation forces are in gray and cyan, Naboo forces are in red, yellow, green, and orange.]]
The number of enemy units in the level varies depending of the difficulty level chosen. In hard mode, a force of three V-19 landspeeders, four Heavy Champions, and two Steadfasts, are stationed outside of Spinnaker. These units attack the player after they take control the village. The forces inside Spinnaker in hard and moderate difficulty consist of eight troopers,<ref name="GB" /> four Tuskcat Troopers,<ref name="CC" /> four heavy landspeeders, two Champions, and one Steadfast. In easy mode, Spinnaker is only defended by its [[Navy/Legends|navy]] and four V-19 landspeeders, and the Naboo village is equipped with two anti-air turrets that the player also acquires along with the forces of the village. The Spinnaker Navy's forces are consistent across all difficulty levels. The Royal Navy has an initial force of pummels, energy catapaults, Royal Crusaders,<ref name="GB" /> Tuskcat Troopers<ref name="CC" /> and Light Scouts in hard mode. These forces are absent in the lower difficulty levels. Throughout the level, Spinnaker and the Royal Navy may create new units with which to attack the player.<ref name="GB" /> This article assumes the units in hard difficulty are canonical.

Naboo mounted troopers rode [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'',<ref name="GB" /> which were replaced with [[Tusk cat]]s in the [[2002]] expansion [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].<ref name="CC" /> Near the Naboo Royal Navy, the player may find two Gungan-affiliated [[glurrg]]s [[Farm/Legends|farming]]. However, an encounter with them would be [[Canon|non-canonical]], as according to the game, the Trade Federation did not learn about the existence of the Gungans until after the Fall of Theed. Several unused audio recordings are included in the files for the level. Several feature a Naboo trooper&mdash;whose voice is distinct from that of the royal trooper who surrenders to the player&mdash;warning that the Trade Federation not to come any closer. In other recordings, Gunray informs the player that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] has arrived and that he can help the player take control of several buildings.<ref name="GB" />
